criteria.passage: I’d ask whether the booking is missing completely, whether it shows up under a different time, or whether the confirmation they got doesn’t match what’s in the account.
criteria.rationale: This explicitly probes the concrete nature of the customer’s issue and distinguishes between possible forms of the booking problem.

criteria.passage: Since there have been recent changes, I’d check what part of the service is actually affected and how that’s impacting the appointment itself.
criteria.rationale: This shows the candidate would identify what service/outcome is affected and assess the impact on the appointment.

criteria.passage: Then I’d repeat it back to make sure I’ve got it right — something like, ‘It sounds like the confirmed booking isn’t showing as expected, and we need to confirm whether it was changed or replaced before I help further.’
criteria.rationale: This is a clear summary of the issue before moving to help, demonstrating problem definition.

annotation.annotation_notes: All three criteria are directly evidenced by the candidate’s stated clarification questions and recap.
